# AL1101: Multiple structured form sources

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/ANcpLua.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |

| Severity | Error |
| Category | `ASP.NET Core` |
| Code fix | No |
| Analyzer | `Al1100ToAl1104FormBindingAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

An endpoint can only have one structured form source. Multiple [FromForm] DTOs or IFormCollections create ambiguity about which parameter receives the form data.
